Hospitality operations platform

Bungalow OS

Property operations and approval-gated automation.

An operations platform connecting reservations, guest accounts, housekeeping, maintenance and finance, with attention on exceptions and decisions that need approval.

In development

The need

Coordinating connected operational work scattered across lists and apps.

Approach

A modular API, command centre, event/worker pipeline, RBAC, audit logs and approval-gated agent. Separate domains span reservation through financial close.

Current scope and limits

A platform developed for one property, not a verified multi-tenant subscription SaaS or customer deployment. External WhatsApp/SMS/email delivery and some provider integrations remain incomplete.

Published information checked on 5 November 2026. An accessible interface is not evidence that every workflow has passed end-to-end testing.
